feeds.title: PolishPod101.com
feeds.description: PolishPod101.com is the fastest, easiest, and most fun way to learn Polish and Polish culture. Start speaking Polish in minutes with audio and video lessons, audio dictionary, and learning community!

feeds.title: To be a teacher
feeds.description: Anna Konarzewska writes ideas for Polish language lessons. She is a certified teacher of the Polish language and the leader of the Gdansk Educational Project 'Creative Pedagogy', under which she runs workshops for interested teachers.

feeds.title: E-polish.eu
feeds.description: A whole range of different materials, tools, and information to help you get to know Polish Language better. Featuring stories, lifstyle, Polish culture, traditions, and cuisine. GLOSSA Polish Language School has specialized in teaching Polish as a foreign language for nearly 20 years.

feeds.title: Transparent » Polish Language Blog
feeds.description: Transparent Language brings powerful, world-class language-learning technology to libraries, educational institutions, government organizations, corporations, and curious individuals. This blog is our place to share our passion for Polish language and culture.

feeds.title: Learn Polish
feeds.description: This Blog is to improve your Polish language by trying our Polish Group Courses, One-to-One Lessons, Polish Easy Readers (e-books), and free Learn a Polish Phrase Service. Blog by Daria Gabryanczyk.

feeds.title: Polski Daily Blog
feeds.description: A platform for Polish language students. Polski Daily offers a wide range of resources for students at all levels, including interactive exercises, audio & video lessons, podcasts, and online classes.

feeds.title: Klub Dialogu Blog
feeds.description: Klub Dialogue Polish Language School for Foreigners is sharing the Polish language, as well as traditions and everyday life in Poland. Here you will find a lot of texts, exercises, audio recordings, and interesting links on various topics and levels of advancement (from A1 to B2) for self-study. Additionally, some articles contain short questions to check correct understanding of the text.
